functions.name: IsValid
functions.docs: An abstraction of the state of a file under source control

functions.name: GetBaseRevForMerge
functions.docs:
Get the revision that we should use as a base when performing a three way merge, does not refresh source control state
@returns a revision identifier or NULL if none exist

functions.name: GetResolveInfo
functions.docs:
Get the file and revision number of the base and remote assets considered in a merge resolve
@returns a valid FResolveInfo if the asset is being resolved, otherwise FResolveInfo::IsValid() will return false

functions.name: GetIconName
functions.docs:
Get the name of the icon graphic we should use to display the state in a UI.
@returns the name of the icon to display

functions.name: GetSmallIconName
functions.docs:
Get the name of the small icon graphic we should use to display the state in a UI.
@returns the name of the icon to display

functions.name: IsLocal
functions.docs: Get whether this file is local to the current user (ie, has never been pushed to anyone else)

functions.name: IsConflicted
functions.docs: Get whether this file is in a conflicted state

functions.name: GetWarningText
functions.docs: Gets the warnings messages associated with this state, if any. Ex 'checkout by other', 'out of date', etc).

functions.name: GetStatusText
functions.docs: Gets the status message associated with this state, if any. This is a superset of the GetWarningText that also includes IsCheckedOut.
